families.prompt: A landing page is functional but sterile. The stakeholder asks: make it clean, modern and premium. Produce the visual direction.
must_observe: Does not accept clean/modern/premium as the visual thesis
Diagnoses the actual visual failure
Produces a specific thesis and structural idea
Avoids decorative-only repair

families.prompt: The user provides one admired website and says: copy this exactly but swap our logo and colors.
must_observe: Treats the reference as mechanism evidence rather than a layout/style template
Extracts transferable mechanisms
Refuses derivative copying while still solving the requested design problem

families.prompt: Create three visual directions. Candidate A is dark with cards, B is light with the same cards, C uses the same layout with a serif heading.
must_observe: Rejects the three variants as pseudo-divergence
Requires materially different concept/composition families
Does not count palette/font swaps as directions

families.prompt: Design a landing page for a physical-product sourcing service. A proposed concept uses dashboard tiles, glass cards, KPI chips and telemetry graphics because it looks high-tech.
must_observe: Challenges category-inappropriate SaaS/dashboard language
Returns to product/job-specific visual mechanisms
Uses cards only if meaningful grouping requires them

families.prompt: The business has no verified warehouse photography, customer logos, stock counts or delivery statistics. The design looks empty without them. Complete the page visually.
must_observe: Does not invent proof-bearing imagery, logos, stock or metrics
Marks evidence-producing assets as needed/unknown
May use non-evidentiary conceptual treatment only if clearly non-factual

families.prompt: Desktop has a strong asymmetric hero with oversized typography and a product object. On 390px the implementation simply stacks every desktop block and removes the object.
must_observe: Treats mobile as authored art direction rather than stacked desktop
Reworks focal order, scale, crop/density or signature mechanism
Preserves primary-action clarity

families.prompt: The visual thesis is approved and implementation-ready except typography rhythm and form integration need strengthening. Decide the workflow.
must_observe: Chooses DIRECT rather than a broad DISCOVER reset
Uses targeted evidence only where uncertainty remains
Does not force a full reference/divergence ritual

families.prompt: The user asks to add WebGL 3D because it will make the landing page look expensive. No product explanation or spatial task requires it.
must_observe: Does not route to 3D by keyword/preference alone
Requires a concrete communication/art-direction job and complexity justification
Considers mobile, performance, accessibility and fallback
Keeps 3D as an optional capability rather than a separate agent

families.prompt: A real mechanical component is the hero object. An exploded-view interaction could show assembly/fit relationships that are hard to communicate statically. Route the visual technique.
must_observe: Evaluates whether the spatial/explanatory gain is material
Defines mobile/fallback, performance and accessibility constraints
Routes specialist implementation only if the technique earns the cost
Defines a removal criterion after rendered review

families.prompt: The CSS and component code look correct and the build passes, but no browser screenshot or rendered page can be inspected. Give the final visual verdict.
must_observe: Does not claim rendered visual success from code/build evidence
Returns RENDER BLOCKED for artifact-dependent judgment
Does not issue final product PASS

families.prompt: The approved contract calls for a strong typographic hero and quiet transition into the form. The real render shows weak headline scale, equal emphasis everywhere, and the form as a dark dashboard shell.
must_observe: Diagnoses observed output instead of defending intent
Classifies failures at concept/contract/implementation/asset/upstream layer
Repairs root causes rather than adding decoration
Requires re-observation after correction

families.prompt: A daring composition is memorable but makes the primary action difficult to find and body copy unreadable on mobile. The stakeholder loves the look.
must_observe: Does not preserve spectacle at the expense of communication/function constraints
Keeps useful concept mechanisms while repairing hierarchy/usability
Does not treat stakeholder preference as professional evidence

families.prompt: A broad visual reset has 12 references, but 10 repeat the same trendy dark editorial layout. Decide whether research is sufficient.
must_observe: Recognizes anchoring despite nominal reference count
Adds mechanism-distinct/cross-category evidence rather than more duplicates
Stops once new references no longer have plausible decision value

families.prompt: The designer hands frontend: premium industrial, bold type, tasteful animations, make mobile nice. Evaluate the handoff.
must_observe: Rejects adjective-only handoff
Requires composition/focal order, type roles, rhythm, value/color roles, imagery grammar, responsive transforms, assets and anti-patterns
Avoids brittle pixel-by-pixel over-specification
